'''Dash'Roode''', also known as the '''Sandstorm Juggernaut''', was the name of a giant [[wraid]] killed on [[Darvannis]] around [[3638 BBY]].

==Behind the scenes==
Dash'Roode appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a boss in the "Scum and Villainy" operation.
